This is where you can set up, manage, and monitor your virtual and human agents to support your users through chat.
To start creating your bot, you'll need to install this plugin
This ServiceNow plugin contains default configurations and setup topics to establish a basic bot.
Within conversational interfaces, we use the term "bots" to describe virtual agents.
Choose what type of requests you want your bot to support
Once you install a plugin, your bot will get prebuilt topics that you can customize to handle common user requests.
IT-related support issues (like resetting a password)
Customer-related support issues (like creating a case)
HR-related requests (like updating a phone number)
You can see other plugins on the ServiceNow Store that contain prebuilt topics specific to different types of requests
